name: Sushi Anaba

menus.name: Nigiri and otsumami menu of the day
menus.note: Edomae-style sushi served at the counter, mostly Nordic seafood; wine pairing 5 glasses DKK 1,500 or DKK 2,100, sake pairing 6 glasses DKK 1,300, tea and juice pairing DKK 1,050

bookingOpens: Online through Superb, for one to five guests at the counter. When a date is full, a waiting list can be joined on the same page.
waitlist: Full dates offer a waiting list through Superb; on 12 October 2026 every remaining date in October showed only the waiting list.
groups: Parties larger than five are asked to contact the restaurant (Anaba@sushianaba.com).
